professionalSummary.text: Has run the financial reporting system in production through month-end closes, including production incident handling.
professionalSummary.witness: Recruiter screen: candidate said he 'ran the close for the group's reporting system' and that the system 'is in production now'; asked about incidents, he described a rehearsal-cycle defect and said the supplier 'still had the pager at that point'.

experienceHighlights.text: Owns the production support rota and the close-window escalation procedure.
experienceHighlights.witness: Drafted the production support rota and the close-window escalation procedure that the programme planned to adopt at cut-over, reviewed by the head of finance systems.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Coordinates production changes with finance and IT during the change window and records own responsibility boundaries.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Coordinated pre-production changes with finance and IT in the programme change window; the live service was still operated by the incumbent supplier, whose service manager handled production incidents during the parallel period.

skills.text: Maintains the close runbook and the service dashboard for the reporting system.
skills.witness: Maintained the close runbook and the service dashboard prototype for the reporting system, updating both after each rehearsal cycle with the timings and the open defects.
